categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Titan Scientific Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the scientific research and technical services industry, providing one-stop laboratory products and supporting services for researchers and quality control personnel. Its main product lines include scientific reagents (high-end and general), specialty chemicals, scientific instruments and consumables, and laboratory construction and scientific research informatization services. The company also engages in OEM production and sales of third-party branded products, forming a comprehensive product matrix.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes proprietary technologies such as flow chemistry, metal ion removal, parallel reaction technology, asymmetric synthesis, chiral analysis, and high-purity preparation techniques. It integrates platform technologies including intelligent warehousing and logistics, user data collection and analysis, compound information processing, intelligent cloud platforms, and industrial internet identification. Production mainly uses OEM manufacturing with some in-house small-batch production capabilities, supported by advanced R&D in chemical synthesis, biochemistry, and laboratory automation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include universities, hospitals, research institutes, government agencies, and innovative R&D enterprises across sectors such as biomedicine, new materials, new energy, environmental protection, food and daily chemicals, analytical testing, and intelligent manufacturing. The company serves over 60,000 customers and supports more than 1 million researchers, including over 150 Fortune 500 companies and comprehensive coverage of major Chinese research institutions and universities.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with a strong presence in the Yangtze River Delta region, which accounts for over 70% of revenue. It also serves customers in North China, Southwest, South China, Central China, Northwest, Northeast, and Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan, and overseas markets. The company is expanding its overseas channels to establish a foundation for its proprietary brands internationally.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Titan operates mainly as a midstream and downstream player in the scientific service supply chain. It designs and develops proprietary products, outsources manufacturing primarily through OEM partners, and integrates third-party branded products. The company also provides comprehensive logistics, warehousing, and scientific service platforms, positioning itself as a comprehensive scientific service provider rather than a raw material supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company pursues a dual-core strategy focusing on independent innovation and industry infrastructure construction. It invests steadily in R&D, emphasizing new product development in chemical reagents, biological reagents, consumables, small instruments, and scientific software. Key R&D projects include microchannel reaction technology, new fluorine-containing probes, intelligent reagent preparation platforms, and green manufacturing processes. The company also prioritizes digital transformation, intelligent warehousing, and platform development to enhance operational efficiency and customer experience.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of proprietary and third-party branded scientific reagents, specialty chemicals, instruments, consumables, and laboratory construction and informatization services. The company employs a direct sales model supplemented by distribution channels. It also generates income from OEM manufacturing services and provides value-added services such as scientific research informatization platforms and laboratory management solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include integrated scientific service companies like Thermo Fisher Scientific, Merck KGaA, Danaher, and Sinopharm Reagent, as well as specialized product companies such as West Long Science and Aladdin, and large domestic agents of foreign brands. Shanghai Titan positions itself as a leading domestic scientific service provider with strong proprietary brands, comprehensive product lines, and integrated logistics and service platforms, aiming to compete effectively against both international giants and specialized domestic players.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.88 billion, representing a 4.11% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 12.89 million, declining 82.23% due to pricing strategies and increased costs amid intensified competition. Total assets grew 10.49% to RMB 4.85 billion, with net assets stable at around RMB 2.79 billion. The company maintains steady R&D investment at about 5.47% of revenue and has improved operating cash flow significantly.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai Titan emphasizes its dual-core strategy of proprietary product innovation and industry infrastructure development to provide high-quality, comprehensive scientific service solutions. Its unique value lies in a broad and deep product portfolio with over 7 million SKUs, strong proprietary brands covering reagents, chemicals, instruments, and software, and an advanced intelligent warehousing and logistics system ensuring timely and reliable delivery. The company also offers integrated scientific research platforms and customized services, enhancing customer experience and supporting import substitution in key product lines.
